description: Test a SKILL.md in the open Agent Skills format (https://agentskills.io/specification — read by Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and others) in two stages. (1) lint: the spec's frontmatter rules checked without a model (name 1-64 chars, lowercase/digits/single hyphens, matches dir_name when given; description 1-1024 chars; compatibility ≤500; metadata string map) — any error returns BLOCK and calls no model; gate on lint.valid, it is deterministic. (2) triggering, measured the way an agent decides: the model sees ONLY the name + description of this skill and of the other installed skills (other_skills, or six built-in neighbours) and answers which one it would load, at temperature 0. trigger_accuracy = share of requests routed correctly (should load / should not); verdict PASS ≥80, FIX ≥50, else BLOCK. Pass your own scenarios [{prompt, should_trigger}] for a reproducible gate; without them requests are generated (half should-load, half near misses) and the result is a signal, flagged by scenarios_source. step_adherence is keyword overlap on the skill body's run and never enters the verdict. A request the model never answered readably (rate limit, empty output) is not counted as a miss: the run is INCONCLUSIVE instead. Uses the server's default Groq model (server key, rate-limited). Pass api_key + model to use your own provider; the SKILL.md and scenarios are sent to ia-qa.com and to that provider.

api_key.description: API key for the chosen model provider. Not required when using the default Groq model.

dir_name.description: Name of the folder holding the SKILL.md. The spec requires name to match it; checked only when given.

lint_only.description: Run the format check only: no model call, no key, deterministic. The CI gate for a SKILL.md — gate on lint.valid.

model.description: LLM model ID to use for both scenario generation and testing (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-haiku-20241022). Defaults to openai/gpt-oss-20b (Groq, server key).

other_skills.description: The other skills installed next to this one, [{"name", "description"}], so triggering is tested against the real neighbours. Default: six built-in generic skills.

scenario_count.description: Number of requests to generate when scenarios is omitted: half should-load, half near misses. Default: 6.

scenarios.description: Fixed user requests for a reproducible gate: [{"prompt": "...", "should_trigger": true}]. Include near misses with should_trigger false. Max 20. When omitted, scenario_count requests are generated.

skill_md.description: Full content of the SKILL.md file to test, YAML frontmatter included.

name: test_skill
